limits: 60required queries in original scope; initial query group covers collections0and4 and export covers only0, not all collections.
100k total across10collections, maximum10k per collection; not single-collection100k quality or performance evidence.
Directory samples are non-atomic logical sums, not strict simultaneous physical disk peak or a guaranteed bound.
Per-stage maximum RSS and native CPU/FS counts retain original process scope. Separate stats processes are not added into inner operation timing.
Original x86_64 Linux officialRust1.80.0/glibc2.41 observations do not establish a glibc2.31 platform result.
Physical IO bytes and old-reader physical extents were unknown, not zero.
Frozen input assets and helper replay materials remain separate publication preparation, not established by these measurement projections.
